text_en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ , by the will of God , and Timothy, a brother:
text_la: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, et Timotheus frater:
text_pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo,
text_el: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς

text_en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ Jesus who are at Colossa .
text_la: eis, qui sunt Colossis, sanctis, et fidelibus fratribus in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Aos santos e irmãos fiéis em Cristo, que estão em Colossos: Graça a vós, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: τοῖς ἐν Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν.

text_en: Grace be to you and peace, from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ . We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you.
text_la: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo. Gratias agimus Deo, et Patri Domini nostri Jesu Christi semper pro vobis orantes:
text_pt: Graças damos a Deus, Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, orando sempre por vós,
text_el: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ πατρὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ [Χριστοῦ] πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι,

text_en: Hearing your faith in Christ Jesus and the love which you have towards all the saints .
text_la: audientes fidem vestram in Christo Jesu, et dilectionem quam habetis in sanctos omnes
text_pt: Porquanto ouvimos da vossa fé em Cristo Jesus, e do amor que tendes para com todos os santos;
text_el: ἀκούσαντες τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην [ἣν ἔχετε] εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους

text_en: For the hope that is laid up for you in heaven , which you have heard in the word of the truth of the gospel ,
text_la: propter spem, quæ reposita est vobis in cælis : quam audistis in verbo veritatis Evangelii:
text_pt: Por causa da esperança que vos está reservada nos céus, da qual já antes ouvistes pela palavra da verdade do evangelho,
text_el: διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τὴν ἀποκειμένην ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ἣν προηκούσατε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῆς ἀληθείας τοῦ εὐαγγελίου

text_en: which has come unto you, as also it is in the whole world and brings forth fruit and grows, even as it does in you, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth .
text_la: quod pervenit ad vos, sicut et in universo mundo est, et fructificat, et crescit sicut in vobis, ex ea die, qua audistis, et cognovistis gratiam Dei in veritate,
text_pt: Que já chegou a vós, como também está em todo o mundo; e já vai frutificando, como também entre vós, desde o dia em que ouvistes e conhecestes a graça de Deus em verdade;
text_el: τοῦ παρόντος εἰς ὑμᾶς, καθὼς καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον καθὼς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐπέγνωτε τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ:

text_en: As you learned of Epaphras, our most beloved fellow servant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ Jesus ;
text_la: sicut didicistis ab Epaphra carissimo conservo nostro, qui est fidelis pro vobis minister Christi Jesu,
text_pt: Como aprendestes de Epafras, nosso amado conservo, que para vós é um fiel ministro de Cristo,
text_el: καθὼς ἐμάθετε ἀπὸ Ἐπαφρᾶ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ συνδούλου ἡμῶν, ὅς ἐστιν πιστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν διάκονος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: who also has manifested your love in the spirit .
text_la: qui etiam manifestavit nobis dilectionem vestram in spiritu.
text_pt: O qual nos declarou também o vosso amor no Espírito.
text_el: ὁ καὶ δηλώσας ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἀγάπην ἐν πνεύματι.

text_en: Therefore we also, from the day that we heard it, cease not to pray for you and to beg that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will , in all wisdom and spiritual understanding:
text_la: Ideo et nos ex qua die audivimus, non cessamus pro vobis orantes, et postulantes ut impleamini agnitione voluntatis ejus, in omni sapientia et intellectu spiritali:
text_pt: Por esta razão, nós também, desde o dia em que o ouvimos, não cessamos de orar por vós, e de pedir que sejais cheios do conhecimento da sua vontade, em toda a sabedoria e inteligência espiritual;
text_el: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς, ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσαμεν, οὐ παυόμεθα ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι καὶ αἰτούμενοι ἵνα πληρωθῆτε τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ συνέσει πνευματικῇ,

text_en: That you may walk worthy of God , in all things pleasing; being fruitful in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God :
text_la: ut ambuletis digne Deo per omnia placentes : in omni opere bono fructificantes, et crescentes in scientia Dei:
text_pt: Para que possais andar dignamente diante do Senhor, agradando-lhe em tudo, frutificando em toda a boa obra, e crescendo no conhecimento de Deus;
text_el: περιπατῆσαι ἀξίως τοῦ κυρίου εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν, ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ καρποφοροῦντες καὶ αὐξανόμενοι τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: Strengthened with all might according to the power of his glory , in all patience and longsuffering with joy ,
text_la: in omni virtute confortati secundum potentiam claritatis ejus, in omni patientia et longanimitate cum gaudio,
text_pt: Corroborados em toda a fortaleza, segundo a força da sua glória, em toda a paciência, e longanimidade com gozo;
text_el: ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει δυναμούμενοι κατὰ τὸ κράτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν ὑπομονὴν καὶ μακροθυμίαν, μετὰ χαρᾶς

text_en: giving thanks to God the Father , who has made us worthy to be partakers of the lot of the saints in light:
text_la: gratias agentes Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctorum in lumine:
text_pt: Dando graças ao Pai que nos fez idôneos para participar da herança dos santos na luz;
text_el: εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ πατρὶ τῷ ἱκανώσαντι ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ φωτί:

text_en: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness and has translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love ,
text_la: qui eripuit nos de potestate tenebrarum, et transtulit in regnum filii dilectionis suæ,
text_pt: O qual nos tirou da potestade das trevas, e nos transportou para o reino do Filho do seu amor;
text_el: ὃς ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μετέστησεν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἀγάπης αὐτοῦ,

text_en: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the remission of sins :
text_la: in quo habemus redemptionem per sanguinem ejus, remissionem peccatorum:
text_pt: Em quem temos a redenção pelo seu sangue, a saber, a remissão dos pecados;
text_el: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν:

text_en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature:
text_la: qui est imago Dei invisibilis, primogenitus omnis creaturæ:
text_pt: O qual é imagem do Deus invisível, o primogênito de toda a criação;
text_el: ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἀοράτου, πρωτότοκος πάσης κτίσεως,

text_en: For in him were all things created in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones, or dominations, or principalities, or powers. All things were created by him and in him.
text_la: quoniam in ipso condita sunt universa in cælis, et in terra, visibilia, et invisibilia, sive throni, sive dominationes, sive principatus, sive potestates : omnia per ipsum et in ipso creata sunt:
text_pt: Porque nele foram criadas todas as coisas que há nos céus e na terra, visíveis e invisíveis, sejam tronos, sejam dominações, sejam principados, sejam potestades. Tudo foi criado por ele e para ele.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα, εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι: τὰ πάντα δι' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται,

text_en: And he is before all: and by him all things consist.
text_la: et ipse est ante omnes, et omnia in ipso constant.
text_pt: E ele é antes de todas as coisas, e todas as coisas subsistem por ele.
text_el: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν.

text_en: And he is the head of the body, the church : who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he may hold the primacy:
text_la: Et ipse est caput corporis Ecclesiæ, qui est principium, primogenitus ex mortuis : ut sit in omnibus ipse primatum tenens:
text_pt: E ele é a cabeça do corpo, da igreja; é o princípio e o primogênito dentre os mortos, para que em tudo tenha a preeminência.
text_el: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ σώματος, τῆς ἐκκλησίας: ὅς ἐστιν [ἡ] ἀρχή, πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, ἵνα γένηται ἐν πᾶσιν αὐτὸς πρωτεύων,

text_en: Because in him, it has well pleased the Father that all fullness should dwell:
text_la: quia in ipso complacuit, omnem plenitudinem inhabitare:
text_pt: Porque foi do agrado do Pai que toda a plenitude nele habitasse,
text_el: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι

text_en: And through him to reconcile all things unto himself, making peace through the blood of his cross , both as to the things that are on earth and the things that are in heaven .
text_la: et per eum reconciliare omnia in ipsum, pacificans per sanguinem crucis ejus, sive quæ in terris, sive quæ in cælis sunt.
text_pt: E que, havendo por ele feito a paz pelo sangue da sua cruz, por meio dele reconciliasse consigo mesmo todas as coisas, tanto as que estão na terra, como as que estão nos céus.
text_el: καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ ἀποκαταλλάξαι τὰ πάντα εἰς αὐτόν, εἰρηνοποιήσας διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ σταυροῦ αὐτοῦ, δι' αὐτοῦ εἴτε τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἴτε τὰ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: And you, whereas you were some time alienated and enemies in mind in evil works :
text_la: Et vos cum essetis aliquando alienati, et inimici sensu in operibus malis:
text_pt: A vós também, que noutro tempo éreis estranhos, e inimigos no entendimento pelas vossas obras más, agora contudo vos reconciliou
text_el: καὶ ὑμᾶς ποτε ὄντας ἀπηλλοτριωμένους καὶ ἐχθροὺς τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς πονηροῖς,

text_en: Yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unspotted and blameless before him:
text_la: nunc autem reconciliavit in corpore carnis ejus per mortem, exhibere vos sanctos, et immaculatos, et irreprehensibiles coram ipso:
text_pt: No corpo da sua carne, pela morte, para perante ele vos apresentar santos, e irrepreensíveis, e inculpáveis,
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ἀποκατήλλαξεν ἐν τῷ σώματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου, παραστῆσαι ὑμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους καὶ ἀνεγκλήτους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ,

text_en: If so you continue in the faith , grounded and settled, and immoveable from the hope of the gospel which you have heard, which is preached in all the creation that is under heaven : whereof I Paul am made a minister .
text_la: si tamen permanetis in fide fundati, et stabiles, et immobiles a spe Evangelii, quod audistis, quod prædicatum est in universa creatura, quæ sub cælo est, cujus factus sum ego Paulus minister.
text_pt: Se, na verdade, permanecerdes fundados e firmes na fé, e não vos moverdes da esperança do evangelho que tendes ouvido, o qual foi pregado a toda criatura que há debaixo do céu, e do qual eu, Paulo, estou feito ministro.
text_el: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

text_en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you and fill up those things that are wanting of the sufferings of Christ , in my flesh, for his body , which is the church :
text_la: Qui nunc gaudeo in passionibus pro vobis, et adimpleo ea quæ desunt passionem Christi, in carne mea pro corpore ejus, quod est Ecclesia:
text_pt: Regozijo-me agora no que padeço por vós, e na minha carne cumpro o resto das aflições de Cristo, pelo seu corpo, que é a igreja;
text_el: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς παθήμασιν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία,

text_en: Whereof I am made a minister according to the dispensation of God , which is given me towards you, that I may fulfil the word of God :
text_la: cujus factus sum ego minister secundum dispensationem Dei, quæ data est mihi in vos, ut impleam verbum Dei:
text_pt: Da qual eu estou feito ministro segundo a dispensação de Deus, que me foi concedida para convosco, para cumprir a palavra de Deus;
text_el: ἧς ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ διάκονος κατὰ τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς πληρῶσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: The mystery which has been hidden from ages and generations , but now is manifested to his saints ,
text_la: mysterium, quod absconditum fuit a sæculis, et generationibus, nunc autem manifestatum est sanctis ejus,
text_pt: O mistério que esteve oculto desde todos os séculos, e em todas as gerações, e que agora foi manifesto aos seus santos;
text_el: τὸ μυστήριον τὸ ἀποκεκρυμμένον ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν νῦν δὲ ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ,

text_en: to whom God would make known the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles , which is Christ , in you the hope of glory .
text_la: quibus voluit Deus notas facere divitias gloriæ sacramenti hujus in gentibus, quod est Christus, in vobis spes gloriæ,
text_pt: Aos quais Deus quis fazer conhecer quais são as riquezas da glória deste mistério entre os gentios, que é Cristo em vós, esperança da glória;
text_el: οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ θεὸς γνωρίσαι τί τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὅ ἐστιν Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης,

text_en: Whom we preach, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus .
text_la: quem nos annuntiamus, corripientes omnem hominem, et docentes omnem hominem, in omni sapientia, ut exhibeamus omnem hominem perfectum in Christo Jesu:
text_pt: A quem anunciamos, admoestando a todo o homem, e ensinando a todo o homem em toda a sabedoria; para que apresentemos todo o homem perfeito em Jesus Cristo;
text_el: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν Χριστῷ:

text_en: Wherein also I labour, striving according to his working which he works in me in power.
text_la: in quo et laboro, certando secundum operationem ejus, quam operatur in me in virtute.
text_pt: E para isto também trabalho, combatendo segundo a sua eficácia, que opera em mim poderosamente.
text_el: εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει.

text_en: For I would have you know what manner of care I have for you and for them that are at Laodicea and whosoever have not seen my face in the flesh:
text_la: Volo enim vos scire qualem sollicitudinem habeam pro vobis, et pro iis qui sunt Laodiciæ, et quicumque non viderunt faciem meam in carne:
text_pt: Porque quero que saibais quão grande combate tenho por vós, e pelos que estão em Laodicéia, e por quantos não viram o meu rosto em carne;
text_el: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί,

text_en: That their hearts may be comforted, being instructed in charity and unto all riches of fullness of understanding, unto the knowledge of the mystery of God the Father and of Christ Jesus :
text_la: ut consolentur corda ipsorum, instructi in caritate, et in omnes divitias plenitudinis intellectus, in agnitionem mysterii Dei Patris et Christi Jesu:
text_pt: Para que os seus corações sejam consolados, e estejam unidos em amor, e enriquecidos da plenitude da inteligência, para conhecimento do mistério de Deus e Pai, e de Cristo,
text_el: ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν, συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως, εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ,

text_en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge .
text_la: in quo sunt omnes thesauri sapientiæ et scientiæ absconditi.
text_pt: Em quem estão escondidos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e da ciência.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι.

text_en: Now this I say, that no man may deceive you by loftiness of words.
text_la: Hoc autem dico, ut nemo vos decipiat in sublimitate sermonum.
text_pt: E digo isto, para que ninguém vos engane com palavras persuasivas.
text_el: τοῦτο λέγω ἵνα μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ.

text_en: For though I be absent in body, yet in spirit I am with you, rejoicing, and beholding your order and the steadfastness of your faith which is in Christ .
text_la: Nam etsi corpore absens sum, sed spiritu vobiscum sum : gaudens, et videns ordinem vestrum, et firmamentum ejus, quæ in Christo est, fidei vestræ.
text_pt: Porque, ainda que esteja ausente quanto ao corpo, contudo, em espírito estou convosco, regozijando-me e vendo a vossa ordem e a firmeza da vossa fé em Cristo.
text_el: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.

text_en: As therefore you have received Jesus Christ the Lord , walk in him:
text_la: Sicut ergo accepistis Jesum Christum Dominum, in ipso ambulate,
text_pt: Como, pois, recebestes o Senhor Jesus Cristo, assim também andai nele,
text_el: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,

text_en: Rooted and built up in him and confirmed in the faith , as also you have learned: abounding in him in thanksgiving.
text_la: radicati, et superædificati in ipso, et confirmati fide, sicut et didicistis, abundantes in illo in gratiarum actione.
text_pt: Arraigados e sobreedificados nele, e confirmados na fé, assim como fostes ensinados, nela abundando em ação de graças.
text_el: ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες [ἐν αὐτῇ] ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.

text_en: Beware lest any man cheat you by philosophy and vain deceit : according to the tradition of men according to the elements of the world and not according to Christ .
text_la: Videte ne quis vos decipiat per philosophiam, et inanem fallaciam secundum traditionem hominum, secundum elementa mundi, et non secundum Christum:
text_pt: Tende cuidado, para que ninguém vos faça presa sua, por meio de filosofias e vãs sutilezas, segundo a tradição dos homens, segundo os rudimentos do mundo, e não segundo Cristo;
text_el: βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν,

text_en: For in him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead corporeally.
text_la: quia in ipso inhabitat omnis plenitudo divinitatis corporaliter:
text_pt: Porque nele habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade;
text_el: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς,

text_en: And you are filled in him, who is the head of all principality and power.
text_la: et estis in illo repleti, qui est caput omnis principatus et potestatis:
text_pt: E estais perfeitos nele, que é a cabeça de todo o principado e potestade;
text_el: καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,

text_en: In whom also you are circumcised with circumcision not made by hand in despoiling of the body of the flesh: but in the circumcision of Christ .
text_la: in quo et circumcisi estis circumcisione non manu facta in expoliatione corporis carnis, sed in circumcisione Christi:
text_pt: No qual também estais circuncidados com a circuncisão não feita por mão no despojo do corpo dos pecados da carne, pela circuncisão de Cristo;
text_el: ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: Buried with him in baptism : in whom also you are risen again by the faith of the operation of God who has raised him up from the dead .
text_la: consepulti ei in baptismo, in quo et resurrexistis per fidem operationis Dei, qui suscitavit illum a mortuis.
text_pt: Sepultados com ele no batismo, nele também ressuscitastes pela fé no poder de Deus, que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos.
text_el: συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτίσματι, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν:

text_en: And you, when you were dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, he has quickened together with him, forgiving you all offences:
text_la: Et vos cum mortui essetis in delictis, et præputio carnis vestræ, convivificavit cum illo, donans vobis omnia delicta:
text_pt: E, quando vós estáveis mortos nos pecados, e na incircuncisão da vossa carne, vos vivificou juntamente com ele, perdoando-vos todas as ofensas,
text_el: καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ, χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,

text_en: Blotting out the handwriting of the decree that was against us, which was contrary to us. And he has taken the same out of the way, fastening it to the cross .
text_la: delens quod adversus nos erat chirographum decreti, quod erat contrarium nobis, et ipsum tulit de medio, affigens illud cruci:
text_pt: Havendo riscado a cédula que era contra nós nas suas ordenanças, a qual de alguma maneira nos era contrária, e a tirou do meio de nós, cravando-a na cruz.
text_el: ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ' ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ:

text_en: And despoiling the principalities and powers , he has exposed them confidently in open show, triumphing over them in himself.
text_la: et expolians principatus, et potestates traduxit confidenter, palam triumphans illos in semetipso.
text_pt: E, despojando os principados e potestades, os expôs publicamente e deles triunfou em si mesmo.
text_el: ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Let no man therefore judge you in food or in drink or in respect of a festival day or of the new moon or of the sabbaths ,
text_la: Nemo ergo vos judicet in cibo, aut in potu, aut in parte diei festi, aut neomeniæ, aut sabbatorum:
text_pt: Portanto, ninguém vos julgue pelo comer, ou pelo beber, ou por causa dos dias de festa, ou da lua nova, ou dos sábados,
text_el: Μὴ οὖν τις ὑμᾶς κρινέτω ἐν βρώσει καὶ ἐν πόσει ἢ ἐν μέρει ἑορτῆς ἢ νεομηνίας ἢ σαββάτων,

text_en: which are a shadow of things to come: but the body is of Christ .
text_la: quæ sunt umbra futurorum : corpus autem Christi.
text_pt: Que são sombras das coisas futuras, mas o corpo é de Cristo.
text_el: ἅ ἐστιν σκιὰ τῶν μελλόντων, τὸ δὲ σῶμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Let no man seduce you, willing in humility and religion of angels , walking in the things which he has not seen, in vain puffed up by the sense of his flesh:
text_la: Nemo vos seducat, volens in humilitate, et religione angelorum, quæ non vidit ambulans, frustra inflatus sensu carnis suæ,
text_pt: Ninguém vos domine a seu bel-prazer com pretexto de humildade e culto dos anjos, envolvendo-se em coisas que não viu; estando debalde inchado na sua carnal compreensão,
text_el: μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς καταβραβευέτω θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων, ἃ ἑόρακεν ἐμβατεύων, εἰκῇ φυσιούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ νοὸς τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And not holding the head, from which the whole body, by joints and bands, being supplied with nourishment and compacted, grows into the increase of God .
text_la: et non tenens caput, ex quo totum corpus per nexus, et conjunctiones subministratum, et constructum crescit in augmentum Dei.
text_pt: E não ligado à cabeça, da qual todo o corpo, provido e organizado pelas juntas e ligaduras, vai crescendo em aumento de Deus.
text_el: καὶ οὐ κρατῶν τὴν κεφαλήν, ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδέσμων ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον αὔξει τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: If then you be dead with Christ from the elements of this world, why do you yet decree as though living in the world?
text_la: Si ergo mortui estis cum Christo ab elementis hujus mundi : quid adhuc tamquam viventes in mundo decernitis?
text_pt: Se, pois, estais mortos com Cristo quanto aos rudimentos do mundo, por que vos carregam ainda de ordenanças, como se vivêsseis no mundo, tais como:
text_el: εἰ ἀπεθάνετε σὺν Χριστῷ ἀπὸ τῶν στοιχείων τοῦ κόσμου, τί ὡς ζῶντες ἐν κόσμῳ δογματίζεσθε,

text_en: Touch not: taste not: handle not.
text_la: Ne tetigeritis, neque gustaveritis, neque contrectaveritis:
text_pt: Não toques, não proves, não manuseies?
text_el: μὴ ἅψῃ μηδὲ γεύσῃ μηδὲ θίγῃς,

text_en: Which all are unto destruction by the very use, according to the precepts and doctrines of men .
text_la: quæ sunt omnia in interitum ipso usu, secundum præcepta et doctrinas hominum:
text_pt: As quais coisas todas perecem pelo uso, segundo os preceitos e doutrinas dos homens;
text_el: ἅ ἐστιν πάντα εἰς φθορὰν τῇ ἀποχρήσει, κατὰ τὰ ἐντάλματα καὶ διδασκαλίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων;

text_en: Which things have indeed a show of wisdom in superstition and humility , and not sparing the body; not in any honour to the filling of the flesh.
text_la: quæ sunt rationem quidem habentia sapientiæ in superstitione, et humilitate, et non ad parcendum corpori, non in honore aliquo ad saturitatem carnis.
text_pt: As quais têm, na verdade, alguma aparência de sabedoria, em devoção voluntária, humildade, e em disciplina do corpo, mas não são de valor algum senão para a satisfação da carne.
text_el: ἅτινά ἐστιν λόγον μὲν ἔχοντα σοφίας ἐν ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ καὶ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀφειδίᾳ σώματος, οὐκ ἐν τιμῇ τινι πρὸς πλησμονὴν τῆς σαρκός.

text_en: Therefore if you be risen with Christ , seek the things that are above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God .
text_la: Igitur, si consurrexistis cum Christo : quæ sursum sunt quærite, ubi Christus est in dextera Dei sedens:
text_pt: Portanto, se já ressuscitastes com Cristo, buscai as coisas que são de cima, onde Cristo está assentado à destra de Deus.
text_el: Εἰ οὖν συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἄνω ζητεῖτε, οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ καθήμενος:

text_en: Mind the things that are above, not the things that are upon the earth.
text_la: quæ sursum sunt sapite, non quæ super terram.
text_pt: Pensai nas coisas que são de cima, e não nas que são da terra;
text_el: τὰ ἄνω φρονεῖτε, μὴ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς:

text_en: For you are dead: and your life is hid with Christ in God .
text_la: Mortui enim estis, et vita vestra est abscondita cum Christo in Deo.
text_pt: Porque já estais mortos, e a vossa vida está escondida com Cristo em Deus.
text_el: ἀπεθάνετε γάρ, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: When Christ shall appear, who is your life, then you also shall appear with him in glory .
text_la: Cum Christus apparuerit, vita vestra : tunc et vos apparebitis cum ipso in gloria.
text_pt: Quando Cristo, que é a nossa vida, se manifestar, então também vós vos manifestareis com ele em glória.
text_el: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς φανερωθῇ, ἡ ζωὴ ἡμῶν, τότε καὶ ὑμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ φανερωθήσεσθε ἐν δόξῃ.

text_en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness , lust , evil concupiscence and covetousness , which is the service of idols .
text_la: Mortificate ergo membra vestra, quæ sunt super terram : fornicationem, immunditiam, libidinem, concupiscentiam malam, et avaritiam, quæ est simulacrorum servitus:
text_pt: Mortificai, pois, os vossos membros, que estão sobre a terra: a fornicação, a impureza, o afeição desordenada, a vil concupiscência, e a avareza, que é idolatria;
text_el: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, πορνείαν, ἀκαθαρσίαν, πάθος, ἐπιθυμίαν κακήν, καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρία,

text_en: For which things the wrath of God comes upon the children of unbelief .
text_la: propter quæ venit ira Dei super filios incredulitatis:
text_pt: Pelas quais coisas vem a ira de Deus sobre os filhos da desobediência;
text_el: δι' ἃ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: In which you also walked some time, when you lived in them.
text_la: in quibus et vos ambulastis aliquando, cum viveretis in illis.
text_pt: Nas quais, também, em outro tempo andastes, quando vivíeis nelas.
text_el: ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν τούτοις:

text_en: But now put you also all away: anger , indignation, malice , blasphemy , filthy speech out of your mouth.
text_la: Nunc autem deponite et vos omnia : iram, indignationem, malitiam, blasphemiam, turpem sermonem de ore vestro.
text_pt: Mas agora, despojai-vos também de tudo: da ira, da cólera, da malícia, da maledicência, das palavras torpes da vossa boca.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπόθεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ πάντα, ὀργήν, θυμόν, κακίαν, βλασφημίαν, αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν:

text_en: Lie not one to another: stripping yourselves of the old man with his deeds ,
text_la: Nolite mentiri invicem, expoliantes vos veterem hominem cum actibus suis,
text_pt: Não mintais uns aos outros, pois que já vos despistes do velho homem com os seus feitos,
text_el: μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους, ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν ταῖς πράξεσιν αὐτοῦ,

text_en: and putting on the new, him who is renewed unto knowledge , according to the image of him that created him .
text_la: et induentes novum eum, qui renovatur in agnitionem secundum imaginem ejus qui creavit illum:
text_pt: E vos vestistes do novo, que se renova para o conhecimento, segundo a imagem daquele que o criou;
text_el: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατ' εἰκόνα τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν,

text_en: Where there is neither Gentile nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian nor Scythian, bond nor free. But Christ is all and in all.
text_la: ubi non est gentilis et Judæus, circumcisio et præputium, Barbarus et Scytha, servus et liber : sed omnia, et in omnibus Christus.
text_pt: Onde não há grego, nem judeu, circuncisão, nem incircuncisão, bárbaro, cita, servo ou livre; mas Cristo é tudo, e em todos.
text_el: ὅπου οὐκ ἔνι Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος, περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία, βάρβαρος, Σκύθης, δοῦλος, ἐλεύθερος, ἀλλὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν Χριστός.

text_en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God , holy and beloved, the bowels of mercy, benignity, humility , modesty, patience:
text_la: Induite vos ergo, sicut electi Dei, sancti, et dilecti, viscera misericordiæ, benignitatem, humilitatem, modestiam, patientiam:
text_pt: Revesti-vos, pois, como eleitos de Deus, santos e amados, de entranhas de misericórdia, de benignidade, humildade, mansidão, longanimidade;
text_el: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι, σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, χρηστότητα, ταπεινοφροσύνην, πραΰτητα, μακροθυμίαν,

text_en: Bearing with one another and forgiving one another, if any have a complaint against another. Even as the Lord has forgiven you, so do you also.
text_la: supportantes invicem, et donantes vobismetipsis si quis adversus aliquem habet querelam : sicut et Dominus donavit vobis, ita et vos.
text_pt: Suportando-vos uns aos outros, e perdoando-vos uns aos outros, se alguém tiver queixa contra outro; assim como Cristo vos perdoou, assim fazei vós também.
text_el: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς ἐάν τις πρός τινα ἔχῃ μομφήν: καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς:

text_en: But above all these things have charity , which is the bond of perfection .
text_la: Super omnia autem hæc, caritatem habete, quod est vinculum perfectionis:
text_pt: E, sobre tudo isto, revesti-vos de amor, que é o vínculo da perfeição.
text_el: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν δὲ τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην, ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος.

text_en: And let the peace of Christ rejoice in your hearts, wherein also you are called in one body: and be thankful.
text_la: et pax Christi exsultet in cordibus vestris, in qua et vocati estis in uno corpore : et grati estote.
text_pt: E a paz de Deus, para a qual também fostes chamados em um corpo, domine em vossos corações; e sede agradecidos.
text_el: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν [ἑνὶ] σώματι: καὶ εὐχάριστοι γίνεσθε.

text_en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you abundantly: in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another in psalms , hymns and spiritual canticles , singing in grace in your hearts to God .
text_la: Verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter, in omni sapientia, docentes, et commonentes vosmetipsos, psalmis, hymnis, et canticis spiritualibus, in gratia cantantes in cordibus vestris Deo.
text_pt: A palavra de Cristo habite em vós abundantemente, em toda a sabedoria, ensinando-vos e admoestando-vos uns aos outros, com salmos, hinos e cânticos espirituais, cantando ao Senhor com graça em vosso coração.
text_el: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως, ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ψαλμοῖς, ὕμνοις, ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς, ἐν χάριτι ᾄδοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν τῷ θεῷ:

text_en: All whatsoever you do in word or in work, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ , giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
text_la: Omne, quodcumque facitis in verbo aut in opere, omnia in nomine Domini Jesu Christi, gratias agentes Deo et Patri per ipsum.
text_pt: E, quanto fizerdes por palavras ou por obras, fazei tudo em nome do Senhor Jesus, dando por ele graças a Deus Pai.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ, πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ θεῷ πατρὶ δι' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Wives, be subject to your husbands, as it behoves in the Lord .
text_la: Mulieres, subditæ estote viris, sicut oportet, in Domino.
text_pt: Vós, mulheres, estai sujeitas a vossos próprios maridos, como convém no Senhor.
text_el: Αἱ γυναῖκες, ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν, ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Husbands, love your wives and be not bitter towards them.
text_la: Viri, diligite uxores vestras, et nolite amari esse ad illas.
text_pt: Vós, maridos, amai a vossas mulheres, e não vos irriteis contra elas.
text_el: οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς.

text_en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing to the Lord .
text_la: Filii, obedite parentibus per omnia : hoc enim placitum est in Domino.
text_pt: Vós, filhos, obedecei em tudo a vossos pais, porque isto é agradável ao Senhor.
text_el: τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα, τοῦτο γὰρ εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Fathers , provoke not your children to indignation, lest they be discouraged.
text_la: Patres, nolite ad indignationem provocare filios vestros, ut non pusillo animo fiant.
text_pt: Vós, pais, não irriteis a vossos filhos, para que não percam o ânimo.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες, μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν.

text_en: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh: not serving to the eye, as pleasing men : but in simplicity of heart, fearing God .
text_la: Servi, obedite per omnia dominis carnalibus, non ad oculum servientes, quasi hominibus placentes, sed in simplicitate cordis, timentes Deum.
text_pt: Vós, servos, obedecei em tudo a vossos senhores segundo a carne, não servindo só na aparência, como para agradar aos homens, mas em simplicidade de coração, temendo a Deus.
text_el: οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις, μὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλ' ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας, φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον.

text_en: Whatsoever you do, do it from the heart, as to the Lord , and not to men :
text_la: Quodcumque facitis, ex animo operamini sicut Domino, et non hominibus:
text_pt: E tudo quanto fizerdes, fazei-o de todo o coração, como ao Senhor, e não aos homens,
text_el: ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε, ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

text_en: Knowing that you shall receive of the Lord the reward of inheritance. Serve the Lord Christ .
text_la: scientes quod a Domino accipietis retributionem hæreditatis. Domino Christo servite.
text_pt: Sabendo que recebereis do Senhor o galardão da herança, porque a Cristo, o Senhor, servis.
text_el: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ κυρίου ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας. τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε:

text_en: For he that does wrong shall receive for that which he has done wrongfully. And there is no respect of persons with God .
text_la: Qui enim injuriam facit, recipiet id quod inique gessit : et non est personarum acceptio apud Deum.
text_pt: Mas quem fizer agravo receberá o agravo que fizer; pois não há acepção de pessoas.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία.

text_en: Masters, do to your servants that which is just and equal: knowing that you also have a master in heaven .
text_la: Domini, quod justum est et æquum, servis præstate : scientes quod et vos Dominum habetis in cælo.
text_pt: Vós, senhores, fazei o que for de justiça e eqüidade a vossos servos, sabendo que também tendes um Senhor nos céus.
text_el: οἱ κύριοι, τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔχετε κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ.

text_en: Be instant in prayer : watching in it with thanksgiving.
text_la: Orationi instate, vigilantes in ea in gratiarum actione:
text_pt: Perseverai em oração, velando nela com ação de graças;
text_el: Τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτερεῖτε, γρηγοροῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ,

text_en: Praying withal for us also, that God may open unto us a door of speech to speak the mystery of Christ (for which also I am bound):
text_la: orantes simul et pro nobis, ut Deus aperiat nobis ostium sermonis ad loquendum mysterium Christi (propter quod etiam vinctus sum),
text_pt: Orando também juntamente por nós, para que Deus nos abra a porta da palavra, a fim de falarmos do mistério de Cristo, pelo qual estou também preso;
text_el: προσευχόμενοι ἅμα καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου, λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι' ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι,

text_en: That I may make it manifest as I ought to speak.
text_la: ut manifestem illud ita ut oportet me loqui.
text_pt: Para que o manifeste, como me convém falar.
text_el: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

text_en: Walk with wisdom towards them that are without, redeeming the time .
text_la: In sapientia ambulate ad eos, qui foris sunt : tempus redimentes.
text_pt: Andai com sabedoria para com os que estão de fora, remindo o tempo.
text_el: Ἐν σοφίᾳ περιπατεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω, τὸν καιρὸν ἐξαγοραζόμενοι.

text_en: Let your speech be always in grace seasoned with salt : that you may know how you ought to answer every man .
text_la: Sermo vester semper in gratia sale sit conditus, ut sciatis quomodo oporteat vos unicuique respondere.
text_pt: A vossa palavra seja sempre agradável, temperada com sal, para que saibais como vos convém responder a cada um.
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι, ἅλατι ἠρτυμένος, εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ ἀποκρίνεσθαι.

text_en: All the things that concern me, Tychicus , our dearest brother and faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord , will make known to you.
text_la: Quæ circa me sunt, omnia vobis nota faciet Tychicus, carissimus frater, et fidelis minister, et conservus in Domino:
text_pt: Tíquico, irmão amado e fiel ministro, e conservo no Senhor, vos fará saber o meu estado;
text_el: Τὰ κατ' ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν κυρίῳ,

text_en: What I have sent to you for this same purpose, that he may know the things that concern you and comfort your hearts:
text_la: quem misi ad vos ad hoc ipsum, ut cognoscat quæ circa vos sunt, et consoletur corda vestra,
text_pt: O qual vos enviei para o mesmo fim, para que saiba do vosso estado e console os vossos corações;
text_el: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο, ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν,

text_en: With Onesimus, a most beloved and faithful brother, who is one of you. All things that are done here, they shall make known to you.
text_la: cum Onesimo carissimo, et fideli fratre, qui ex vobis est. Omnia, quæ hic aguntur, nota facient vobis.
text_pt: Juntamente com Onésimo, amado e fiel irmão, que é dos vossos; eles vos farão saber tudo o que por aqui se passa.
text_el: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν: πάντα ὑμῖν γνωρίσουσιν τὰ ὧδε.

text_en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, salutes you: and Mark , the cousin german of Barnabas , touching whom you have received commandments. If he come unto you, receive him.
text_la: Salutat vos Aristarchus concaptivus meus, et Marcus consobrinus Barnabæ, de quo accepistis mandata : si venerit ad vos, excipite illum:
text_pt: Aristarco, que está preso comigo, vos saúda, e Marcos, o sobrinho de Barnabé, acerca do qual já recebestes mandamentos; se ele for ter convosco, recebei-o;
text_el: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἀρίσταρχος ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου, καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρναβᾶ περὶ οὗ ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς, ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν,

text_en: And Jesus that is called Justus: who are of the circumcision . These only are my helpers, in the kingdom of God : who have been a comfort to me.
text_la: et Jesus, qui dicitur Justus : qui sunt ex circumcisione : hi soli sunt adjutores mei in regno Dei, qui mihi fuerunt solatio.
text_pt: E Jesus, chamado Justo; os quais são da circuncisão; são estes unicamente os meus cooperadores no reino de Deus; e para mim têm sido consolação.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος, οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν μοι παρηγορία.

text_en: Epaphras salutes you, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus , who is always solicitous for you in prayers , that you may stand perfect and full in all the will of God .
text_la: Salutat vos Epaphras, qui ex vobis est, servus Christi Jesu, semper sollicitus pro vobis in orationibus, ut stetis perfecti, et pleni in omni voluntate Dei.
text_pt: Saúda-vos Epafras, que é dos vossos, servo de Cristo, combatendo sempre por vós em orações, para que vos conserveis firmes, perfeitos e consumados em toda a vontade de Deus.
text_el: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν, δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς, ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: For I bear him testimony that he has much labour for you and for them that are at Laodicea and them at Hierapolis .
text_la: Testimonium enim illi perhibeo quod habet multum laborem pro vobis, et pro iis qui sunt Laodiciæ, et qui Hierapoli.
text_pt: Pois eu lhe dou testemunho de que tem grande zelo por vós, e pelos que estão em Laodicéia, e pelos que estão em Hierápolis.
text_el: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱεραπόλει.

text_en: Luke , the most dear physician, salutes you: and Demas.
text_la: Salutat vos Lucas, medicus carissimus, et Demas.
text_pt: Saúda-vos Lucas, o médico amado, e Demas.
text_el: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ὁ ἰατρὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς καὶ Δημᾶς.

text_en: Salute the brethren who are at Laodicea : and Nymphas and the church that is in his house.
text_la: Salutate fratres, qui sunt Laodiciæ, et Nympham, et quæ in domo ejus est, ecclesiam.
text_pt: Saudai aos irmãos que estão em Laodicéia e a Ninfa e à igreja que está em sua casa.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν κατ' οἶκον αὐτῆς ἐκκλησίαν.

text_en: And when this epistle shall have been read with you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans : and that you read that which is of the Laodiceans .
text_la: Et cum lecta fuerit apud vos epistola hæc, facite ut et in Laodicensium ecclesia legatur : et eam, quæ Laodicensium est, vos legatis.
text_pt: E, quando esta epístola tiver sido lida entre vós, fazei que também o seja na igreja dos laodicenses, e a que veio de Laodicéia lede-a vós também.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ παρ' ὑμῖν ἡ ἐπιστολή, ποιήσατε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ Λαοδικέων ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀναγνωσθῇ, καὶ τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικείας ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀναγνῶτε.

text_en: And say to Archippus: Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord , that you fulfil it.
text_la: Et dicite Archippo : Vide ministerium, quod accepisti in Domino, ut illud impleas.
text_pt: E dizei a Arquipo: Atenta para o ministério que recebeste no Senhor, para que o cumpras.
text_el: καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ, βλέπε τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν κυρίῳ, ἵνα αὐτὴν πληροῖς.

text_en: The salutation of Paul with my own hand. Be mindful of my bands. Grace be with you. Amen .
text_la: Salutatio, mea manu Pauli. Memores estote vinculorum meorum. Gratia vobiscum. Amen.
text_pt: Saudação de minha mão, de Paulo. Lembrai-vos das minhas prisões. A graça seja convosco. Amém.
text_el: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου. μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν. ἡ χάρις μεθ' ὑμῶν.
